title: 2024年6月四级真题 第2套 阅读1
paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 People often wonder why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others. Is it habits, connections, luck, work ethic or any other behavior? I believe the key to success is willpower. Willpower is the ability to control yourself. It is a strong determination that allows you to do something difficult. It is a behavior we are born with more than one we learn; however, it is possible to not only learn it, but also strengthen it with constant exercise.

P2 Willpower is just like a muscle; to keep it strong you need to constantly exercise it. People with a great amount of willpower have the discipline to develop positive, successful habits. Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success.

P3 Willpower and habits go hand in hand. It is critical to create good habits and take the actions necessary to stick to those habits day in and day out for greater success. Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.

P4 The best way to create and stick to a habit is to have strong motivation. It's easier to change your habits to lose weight if you have a health issue and you want to be around longer for your kids, or if your business is something you're passionate about. Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently.

P5 The art of self-control is one that most successful individuals have mastered. Self-control enables you to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do.

P6 Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track. However, if you work on sticking to those small positive habits one day at a time, it becomes easier to stay strong and achieve that delayed reward. Once a reward is achieved, it is much easier to continue sticking to your habits.

questions.q: What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower?
options: Keep it under control.
Apply it continuously.
Learn from entrepreneurs.
Aim at success determinedly.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower? 用 what...need to do 句式直接问具体做法，不含 infer/imply/mainly about，是标准的细节 题问法。 46. What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower? A) Keep it under control. B) Apply it continuously. C) Learn from entrepreneurs. D) Aim at success determinedly.

【拆句】What does the author say we need to do to strengthen our willpower? 主干是 what does the author say (that) we need to do，后面的 to strengthen our willpower 是 目的状语；翻译时把目的状语提到前面："为了强化意志力，作者说我们需要做什么"。无 陷阱。

【定位】Willpower is just like a muscle; to keep it strong you need to constantly exercise it. 意志力就像一块肌肉；要让它保持强壮，你需要不断地锻炼它。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 原文说意志力本身就是 the ability to control yourself，是控制者，不是被控对象； Keep it under control. 把主客关系倒置。 B) ✓ 正确 constantly exercise it ↔Apply it continuously. 预判"持续锻炼"与 Apply it continuously. 字面同义，是 constantly exercise it 的标准 同义替换，无需推断。 C) 无中生有 why some entrepreneurs have greater success than others 只是引出话题的例子， 文中并未要求读者"向企业家学习"以强化意志力。 D) 张冠李戴 strong determination that allows you to do something difficult 说的是意志力"能让 人坚定追求成功"，是它的功能；选项把功能当成强化方法，张冠李戴。 根据文章,我们几乎一半的日常行为是如何进行的? A) 出于习惯。 B) 凭借决心。 C) 像锻炼肌肉一样。 D) 通过自律。

questions.q: How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage?
options: Out of habit.
With determination.
Like muscle building.
By self-discipline.
questions.explain:
【判型】How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage? 用 how 询问客观执行方式，并加 according to the passage 强调贴文回答，是细节题。

【拆句】How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage? 这是 how 引导的被动语态疑问句，主语是 almost half of our daily actions，谓语 are performed；according to the passage 是状语。考生若不熟悉被动，需理解为"我们日常 行为中近一半是如何被完成的"。 47. How are almost half of our daily actions performed according to the passage? A) Out of habit. B) With determination. C) Like muscle building. D) By self-discipline.

【定位】Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis. 我们日常行为中近一半属于习惯而不是决定，因此一旦正确习惯到位，你就会每天自动去做 那些事。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 are part of our habits and not decisions ↔Out of habit. 预判"出于习惯"与 Out of habit. 字面一致，是 are part of our habits 的标准同义 替换。 B) 与原文相反 are part of our habits and not decisions 已明说"不是决定"；With determination. 与 decision 同属"有意识决断"的语义场，正好被否定。 C) 张冠李戴 muscle building 来自 Willpower is just like a muscle 的比喻，与 Q47 的执行方式无 关，被借来制造干扰。 D) 张冠李戴 self-discipline 与 Self-control 同义，但 P5 谈的是自控的功能，不是"日常行为如何被 执行"，被借来诱导。 什么会帮助人们自动坚持做有建设性的事情? A) 在日常生活中练习它。 B) 将它与改善健康联系起来。 C) 拥有合理的天赋。 D) 预见它将产生的预期结果。

questions.q: What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically?
options: Practising it on a day-to-day basis.
Associating it with improving health.
Possessing a reasonable amount of talent.
Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield.
questions.explain:
【判型】What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically? 是 what + 具体行为，问"什么会帮助"，求客观条件，属细节题。

【拆句】What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically? 主干 What will help people (to) stick to doing something；stick to 后接动名词 doing； constructive 与 automatically 分别修饰"事"和"做"。基础薄弱者要注意 stick to 不是"棍 子"，而是固定搭配"坚持"。

【定位】Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently. 把一个有价值的结果与某个习惯绑定，会帮助你长期坚持那个习惯。 48. What will help people stick to doing something constructive automatically? A) Practising it on a day-to-day basis. B) Associating it with improving health. C) Possessing a reasonable amount of talent. D) Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis 中 day-to-day 是养成习惯后"自动每日去做"的结果；选项把结果当方法，因果倒置。 B) 以偏概全 if you have a health issue 只是说明"有价值结果"的一个例子；选项把例子当成普适条 件，以偏概全。 C) 与原文相反 Even with an incredible amount of talent, without the discipline and motivation to create positive habits, it can be difficult to achieve success. 明确说光有天赋不 够；选项却把"有一定天赋"当成坚持习惯的条件，与原文相反。 D) ✓ 正确 Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit ↔ Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield. 预判"预见到有价值回报"的语义被 Foreseeing the desired outcome it will yield. 精确 承担，是 P4 段尾结论句的同义替换。 自我控制的艺术如何帮助我们成功? A) 通过让我们永久保持头脑清醒。 B) 通过使我们能够不断改变行为。 C) 通过使我们能够采取积极行动。 D) 通过让我们避免冒险。

questions.q: How does the art of self-control help us succeed?
options: By allowing us to remain clear-headed permanently.
By enabling us to alter our behaviors constantly.
By enabling us to take positive actions
By allowing us to avoid taking risks.
questions.explain:
【判型】How does the art of self-control help us succeed? 用 how 询问机制，要求贴文给出 self-control 起作用的方式，属细节题。

【拆句】How does the art of self-control help us succeed? 主干 How does X help us (to) succeed；help 后省略 to，接动词原形 succeed。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。

【定位】Self-control enables you to avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success and adopt those that do. 自控让你能够避开那些无助于成功的行为，并采纳那些有助于成功的行为。 49. How does the art of self-control help us succeed? A) By allowing us to remain clear-headed permanently. B) By enabling us to alter our behaviors constantly. C) By enabling us to take positive actions D) By allowing us to avoid taking risks.

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文未提"保持头脑清醒"，更未说 permanently；选项凭空生造"永远清醒"。 B) 与原文相反 原文说自控让人"避开无益行为、采纳有益行为"，是有方向的取舍；alter our behaviors constantly 暗示"不断改来改去"，与作者"养成稳定好习惯"的立场相反。 C) ✓ 正确 adopt those that do ↔By enabling us to take positive actions Self-control enables you to ↔By enabling us to 预判同时含"避开"与"采纳"两面，选项 By enabling us to take positive actions 抓住其 中"采纳正向行为"的一面，是定位句的合法概括（避开 negative = 接近 positive，二者 同向）。 D) 偷换概念 原文是 avoid behaviors that don't contribute to your success，避的是"无益行为"， 不是 risks；"风险"是文中从未出现的概念。 为什么保持自我控制对我们来说可能很困难? A) 我们大多数人没有锻炼自我控制的习惯。 B) 我们可能无法从自我控制中获得即时回报。 C) 自我控制往往与痛苦相关联。 D) 自我控制只能带来微小的好处。

questions.q: Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control?
options: Most of us are not in the habit of exercising self-control.
We may not get immediate rewards from self-control.
Self-control tends to be associated with pains.
Self-control only brings about small benefits.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control? 用 why 问"难以保持自控"的客观 原因，答案要能在文中找到，按细节题处理。

【拆句】Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control? 这是 why 引导的疑问句 + 形式 主语句型：it 形式主语，真主语是 to maintain self-control；can 表示"有可能、可能会"的 可能性，不要误译成"能够"。

【定位】Because there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control, it can be easy to get off track. 因为自控带来的是延迟的满足感，所以人很容易脱离正轨。 50. Why can it be difficult for us to maintain self-control? A) Most of us are not in the habit of exercising self-control. B) We may not get immediate rewards from self-control. C) Self-control tends to be associated with pains. D) Self-control only brings about small benefits.

【选项】A) 无中生有 原文反复强调正确习惯一旦养成就会 automatically perform；选项却说"我们大多数人 没有自控的习惯"，与作者立场相反，且并非作者给出的难维持原因。 B) ✓ 正确 there is a delayed satisfaction associated with self-control ↔ We may not get immediate rewards from self-control. 预判"回报被推迟"被 We may not get immediate rewards from self-control. 精确承 担，是 because 句的正反同义改写。 C) 无中生有 原文谈的是 delayed satisfaction，是"满足感被推迟"，并非 pains"痛苦"；作者从未把 自控与痛苦绑定。 D) 偷换概念 原文说 if you work on sticking to those small positive habits...it becomes easier to...achieve that delayed reward，重点是"小习惯"带来"延迟的大回报"；small benefits 把延迟错读成"好处本身小"。
